scripts.title: Script for
scripts.features:
Aimbot
Enable Aimbot: The master toggle for all aim-assist functionality.
Aim on Right Click / Keybind: Choose between holding the right mouse button or pressing a customizable
Auto lock for Mobile

Targeting :
Team Check: Prevents locking onto teammates.
Wallcheck: Prevents locking onto targets hidden behind walls.

Customization:
FOV Radius: A slider to control the size of the aimbot's activation circle around your cursor.
FOV Circle: A visual circle on your screen that shows the current FOV radius.
Smoothness: A slider to control how quickly the aimbot snaps to its target.
Target Part: A dropdown menu to select which body part to aim for ("Head" or "HumanoidRootPart").

Visuals (buggy)
Enable ESP: The master toggle for all visual features.
3D Boxes: Draws a box around enemy players.
Names: Displays the name of enemy players.
Skeletons: Draws a skeleton outline on enemy players.

Other Features
Autoshoot: Automatically fires when your aimlocked on enemy player.
Teleport Behind Target: instantly teleport behind the nearest enemy
Low GFX Mode: Drastically reduces graphics settings
FPS Cap: A slider to set a custom fps limit.
